stubs.how: no-op stub in .ui-capture/stubs/sass-embedded.rb; JKAN ships plain CSS, so nothing is ever compiled

notes: JKAN is a Jekyll static site, so this is its production build (JEKYLL_ENV=production) in .ui-capture/out, built with .ui-capture/build.sh. Ruby 4.0.9 and Node 24.22.3 are pinned in mise.toml (precompiled Ruby; sigstore attestation turned off because it is unreachable, checksum still verified). rubygems.org is blocked, so fetch-gems.sh downloads the exact Gemfile.lock versions of Jekyll 4.4.1 and its pure-Ruby dependencies/plugins as GitHub source tarballs into .ui-capture/vendor, and jekyll.rb runs Jekyll from them via $LOAD_PATH (no Bundler). build.sh copies the repo into .ui-capture/site-src (the checkout itself is untouched), runs seed/generate.rb there, and builds with _config.yml plus the overlay _config.ui-capture.yml (site title/greeting 'Westbrook Open Data', baseurl '' so it serves from /, schema: westbrook). DATA: a fictional mid-size city portal, 'City of Westbrook', written the way the CMS writes it: 17 department organizations (_organizations/*.md, each with an SVG logo in img/organizations) and 113 datasets (_datasets/*.md) with 320 resources (csv/geojson/shp/api/pdf/xlsx, per-year files), spread over all 14 categories (many datasets have more than one), with mixed licenses (PDDL, CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, ODbL, none), maintainers and emails. It uses JKAN's schema customization (_data/schemas/westbrook.yml = default + Last Updated / Update Frequency / Time Period), with last-updated dates from 2021 to Nov 2026. It includes real-world messiness: archived COVID datasets, a dataset with an empty description, a few resources with no format, datasets from partner bodies that have no organization page (Housing Authority, School District, Fleet, GIS Services Group), uncategorized datasets, and short and long markdown descriptions. The JKAN sample dataset/department are replaced (as a real deployer would do). MAIN AREAS: / home (hero + category tiles), /datasets/ (searchable list with client-side category and organization filters, e.g. /datasets/?category=public-safety), /datasets/<slug>/ (organization card, resources with Details toggles, Additional Info table), /organizations/ and /organizations/<slug>/, /categories/ and /categories/<slug>/, /editor/ (CMS login screen), /data.json and /datasets.json (Project Open Data catalogs). Category links in the templates omit the trailing slash (/categories/public-safety); a normal static server redirects them to the directory. To rebuild: .ui-capture/build.sh.
